module: Flowgraph node "Groundmarker Remaining Distance" (category repeat_instant, depends on core_groundMarkers). Gives the remaining distance (m) to the target of the active groundmarkers. Outputs: active (flow, only if a path exists) and distance.

work.desc: Reads core_groundMarkers.routePlanner.path[1].distToTarget; active = false if there is no path.
